profile.headline: Software Engineer at Verisign
profile.summary: As a Senior in the Christopher Newport University, I strive to complete tasks and achieve my goals with creativity and a strong work ethic. I am pursuing a double major in Computer Science and Cybersecurity.

positions.title: Information Technology Consultant
positions.description:
•	Help students with resolving issues related to any software configuration with their laptops, iPads and smartphones on any platform.
•	Worked with college staff in documenting standard procedures of solutions provided in resolving major issues.
•	Debugging Students technology problems and resolving it in timely manner.   with install/upgrade and remove the software.

positions.title: Java & Python Instructor
positions.description:
•	Tutoring high school students with advance level of Java and Python.
•	Java Classes includes teaching Linked List, Data Structure etc. 
•	Worked with students on some project such as “Making robots”, “Code Games” in java, and some animations.

positions.title: Innovate Cyber Program
positions.description:
•	Understanding of cyber security and gain experience about modern day.
•	In this program, cyber security including things like design thinking, ethical issues for cyber security, and other various topics that can innovate cyber security.

positions.title: Front Desk
positions.description:
•	Interact with customers in a respectable manner on day-to-day basis.
•	Routine job of check ins and outs of a social workplace environment.  
•	Taking reservation, arranging schedules shuttle service for pick up/drop off customers. 
•	Closing for the end of the day.  
•	Managing large accounts booking process and comforting their needs.

positions.title: Youth Basketball Coach
positions.description:
•	Design and implemented practice sessions for youth basketball players ranging from 8-14.
•	Organize, Maintained and stored basketball equipment as well set-up the basketball training court.
•	Make plays and help team to execute it.
•	Mentor the team to bring confidence to team players.

honors.title: Honors Program
honors.description: Honors Program is one of the most challenging programs at CNU. In this we take very difficult classes tying two topics together such as computer science and theology to try to gain more knowledge in these topics. Along with this, we got to 4 events a semester to hear lectures about such topics.
honors.issuer: Issued by Christopher Newport University · Aug 2018

honors.title: Presidential Leadership Program
honors.description: In this program, we not only volunteer for 30 hours a semester, but on top of this we learn leadership roles along with getting a leadership minor.
honors.issuer: Issued by Christopher Newport University · Aug 2018

organizations.name: Cybersecurity Club
organizations.description: In this club, we get hands-on experience with cybersecurity issues to gain knowledge about the topic. Along with this, we go to conferences from time to time for competitions.
